title: Heavy Rotation
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi is wearing white now.

He wears black on the day after he wears white, and he wears white on the day after he wears black.

What color will he wear $N$ days later?

## Constraints

- $N$ is an integer.
- $1 \leq N \leq 30$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

If he will wear white $N$ days later, print `White`; if he will wear black, print `Black`.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

高桥现在穿着白色衣服。

他在穿白色衣服的第二天会穿黑色衣服，在穿黑色衣服的第二天会穿白色衣服。

$N$ 天后他会穿什么颜色的衣服？

## 约束条件

- $N$ 是整数。
- $1 \leq N \leq 30$

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N
```

## 输出格式

如果 $N$ 天后他会穿白色衣服，输出 `White`；如果会穿黑色衣服，输出 `Black`。

samples.note: Takahashi will wear black one day later and wear white two days later.
